title: Shortness of Breath
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} is a child presenting with chronic cough, recurrent respiratory infections, shortness of breath, and failure to thrive. Exam reveals nasal polyps, clubbing, and diffuse crackles. Cystic fibrosis is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by a mutation in the CFTR gene on chromosome 7. The defect in chloride transport leads to thick, viscous secretions affecting the lungs, pancreas, GI tract, and reproductive system. Diagnosis is made by elevated sweat chloride test (>60 mEq/L). CXR shows hyperinflation and bronchiectasis. Management includes pancreatic enzyme replacement, fat-soluble vitamin supplementation, airway clearance techniques, and aggressive treatment of pulmonary infections.
chief_complaint: Chronic cough, dyspnea, recurrent infections, poor growth

stacks.label: Physical Exam: General Appearance
stacks.finding: Full pediatric exam for chronic disease.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Chest / Lungs
stacks.finding: Respiratory symptoms — thorough lung exam. Crackles, wheezes.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Abdomen
stacks.finding: Assess for hepatosplenomegaly, failure to thrive.

stacks.label: Sweat chloride test
stacks.finding: Gold standard for CF diagnosis. >60 mEq/L = positive.

stacks.label: Sputum culture
stacks.finding: Pseudomonas aeruginosa, S. aureus, H. influenzae common in CF.

stacks.label: Pancreatic elastase, stool
stacks.finding: Assess pancreatic insufficiency — common in CF.

stacks.label: Pulmonary function tests
stacks.finding: Obstructive pattern. FEV1 monitoring guides therapy.

stacks.label: Pancreatic enzyme replacement
stacks.finding: CREON or similar — replaces digestive enzymes for malabsorption.

stacks.label: Fat-soluble vitamins (ADEK)
stacks.finding: Supplementation required due to fat malabsorption.

stacks.label: Airway clearance therapy
stacks.finding: Chest physiotherapy, PEP valve, vest therapy.

stacks.label: Consult, pediatric pulmonology
stacks.finding: CF center referral for multidisciplinary care.

physical_exam.general: Poor growth, low BMI — failure to thrive.
physical_exam.respiratory: Diffuse crackles, wheezes. Chronic productive cough.

decoys.label: Asthma diagnosis without further workup
decoys.reason_wrong: Chronic respiratory symptoms + failure to thrive + clubbing = not typical asthma. CF must be ruled out with sweat chloride test.

teach_me_steps.reasoning: >60 mEq/L confirms CF. CFTR gene testing for specific mutation. Autosomal recessive — chromosome 7, ΔF508 most common.
Pancreatic enzymes + fat-soluble vitamins + airway clearance + aggressive antibiotic treatment of pulmonary infections. Refer to CF center.

case_summary: CF in child. Chronic cough + recurrent infections + failure to thrive + clubbing + nasal polyps. Sweat chloride >60 confirms. CFTR testing. Pancreatic enzymes + ADEK vitamins + airway clearance + pulm referral.
